text:
Maya (Finance Ops): Heads up 5 reseller 'DataWeave' flagged GCP marketplace invoice mismatch. Their downstream billing system shows customer IDs mapped differently vs the marketplace export; looks like two different customer_ids billed under same reseller account. They9re asking for a consolidated credit + corrected mapping for next settlement.

Omar (Partner Ops): Can you paste the export rows that's causing the confusion? is this a tagging issue or a GCP export bug?

Maya (Finance Ops): CSV snippet from GCP settlement export:

```
reseller_id,partner_customer_id,gcp_customer_alias,sku,units,amount
res_007,pcust_1001,customer-alpha,gcp-embed-hr,1,250.00
res_007,pcust_2002,customer-alpha,gcp-embed-hr,1,250.00
```

Note: partner_customer_id values differ (pcust_1001 vs pcust_2002) but gcp_customer_alias is identical (customer-alpha). That produced two invoice lines totalling $500 when the end-customer only uses one seat.

Sam (Revenue Ops): Sounds like a mapping collision during partner onboarding where two internal partner_customer_id values were created for the same downstream customer. We need to (1) credit $250 gross, (2) reconcile which partner_customer_id is canonical, (3) update mapping so future exports use the canonical id. Also checklist: commission reversal, marketplace withholding, and tax treatment.

Pri (Accounting): For the credit memo we need: original invoice id, settlement run id (GCP-SET-20241001), and a short audit memo with export lines. Is the gross credit $250 or $500? Which line is the duplicate?

Maya (Finance Ops): Confirmed duplicate of the same seat; gross overcharge is $250. We'll issue one credit memo for $250. Partner commission is 15% of gross (contract); marketplace withhold on refunds = 5% per GCP policy. If tax applies, we adjust accordingly.

Marketplace Bot: Created ticket FIN-5033: "GCP reseller customer_id mapping collision - DataWeave". Assigned to @omar and @pri.

Omar (Partner Ops): I'll reconcile with the partner and ask them to confirm canonical partner_customer_id (asking CS to confirm with DataWeave). Also will request partner-signed acceptance of the credit to avoid disputes.

Sam (Revenue Ops): Accounting flow proposal: Credit memo $250 gross, commission reversal $37.50 (15%), marketplace withholding $12.50 (5%), net credit to partner $250 - $12.50 = $237.50. Record JE: Reverse revenue $250 DR, reverse commission accrual $37.50 CR, record marketplace payable $12.50 CR. Pri, can you prepare JEs once partner confirms?

Pri (Accounting): Yes will prepare JE and require partner acceptance + original invoice (INV-GCP-20241001-DW). Also need to check if VAT was charged on original; if so we may need VAT reclaim. Tagging this for the month-end audit pack.

Omar (Partner Ops): CS asked partner for canonical id; they replied they merged accounts and confirmed pcust_1001 is canonical. They attached acceptance: "DataWeave confirms pcust_1001 is canonical and accepts a $250 credit for duplicate billing." I'll upload signed PDF to FIN-5033.

Maya (Finance Ops): Great. Proceed to draft credit memo CM-5033-1 for $250, mark as "partner-accepted" and submit to accounting. Pri, please tag the JE to FIN-5033.

Pri (Accounting): Drafted CM-5033-1, JE ready. Posting once invoice and signed acceptance are attached. Will post before next settlement to avoid manual cash movements. cc accounting@redwood.com.

Sam (Revenue Ops): Mark subscription for mapping fix and coordinate with eng to dedupe partner_customer mapping on export pipeline. @eng-sre please watch FIN-5033.

Maya (Finance Ops): Thanks all. I'll update thread when credit memo posts and when mapping fix ships. :white_check_mark:
